agent_assessment: Implementation matches the plan precisely. Two files created (identity.go, identity_test.go) in packages/cli-core/cliutil/. All 8 specified test cases pass. Struct fields and JSON tags match the agent-manager's canonical Claims and IdentityVerifyResult types exactly (verified by comparing identity.go lines 25-41 against agent-manager identity/claims.go and orchestration/service.go:153-158). Design decisions D1-D7 from the plan are all correctly implemented: env var constants exported (D7), DetermineAPIBase used for URL resolution (D1), zero-parameter VerifyIdentity on IdentityEnv (D2), token-only struct (D3), transport/auth error separation (D4), fresh HTTPClient per call with 10s timeout (D5), 401 handling via errors.As + APIError.RawResponse (D6). No new dependencies added to go.mod. Build succeeds cleanly.
notes: The spec.json described IdentityEnv with all claim fields (RunID, TaskID, etc.), but the plan correctly refined this to token-only struct with claims returned via VerifyResult — implementation follows the plan, not the earlier spec description
go.mod unchanged — zero external dependencies confirmed

evidence.title: Contract alignment — VerifiedClaims matches agent-manager Claims
evidence.description: Compared VerifiedClaims fields (identity.go:25-33) against agent-manager's identity.Claims (identity/claims.go:6-14). All JSON tags match exactly: run_id, task_id, profile_key, scope_path, iat, exp, meta. Only difference is cli-core uses string instead of uuid.UUID for RunID/TaskID, which is the correct design decision (D3) to avoid external deps.

evidence.title: Contract alignment — VerifyResult matches IdentityVerifyResult
evidence.description: Compared VerifyResult fields (identity.go:36-41) against agent-manager's IdentityVerifyResult (orchestration/service.go:153-158). All JSON tags match: valid, claims (omitempty), run_status (omitempty), error (omitempty). RunStatus is string in cli-core vs domain.RunStatus in agent-manager — compatible since domain.RunStatus is a string type.

evidence.title: Pattern consistency — mirrors sandbox.go structure
evidence.description: identity.go follows the same pattern as sandbox.go: exported env detection function (DetectIdentity vs DetectSandbox), struct holding env state (IdentityEnv vs SandboxEnv), boolean presence check (IsIdentityPresent vs IsSandboxActive). The plan's refinement of adding exported env var constants (EnvIdentityToken, EnvAgentManagerBase) is an improvement over sandbox.go's inline strings.
